review_title: Very disapointing stay! And disapointing follow up. No reply from manager.
review_text: Big disappointment following our recent two-night stay at the Conrad Bora Bora Nui. The resort is beautiful, rooms are great and bar/restaurant/housekeeping staff is really kind and professional. Unfortunately, our experience was marked by a succession of incidents and service failures which, taken individually, might have seemed minor, but whose accumulation is, in our view, difficult to accept from a hotel of this category. On our very first evening, the turndown service was not carried out, and in particular, we did not receive the in-room incense ritual that was supposed to be provided. When we reported this, we were told that we had probably activated the "Do Not Disturb" sign. However, we had specifically checked before leaving for dinner that this was not the case. The following day, we received our departure letter together with a statement of our expenses and noticed that the transfer between the airport and the hotel had been charged twice! We immediately reported the error through our personal concierge via WhatsApp. Having received no response, we had to follow up later that evening before the error was eventually acknowledged. Our return flight had also been delayed, with departure scheduled for 6:00 p.m. instead of 3:30 p.m. We therefore asked, again through the WhatsApp concierge, whether a late check-out might be possible or, alternatively, whether we could have access to a transit room. We were informed that late check-out was unavailable, but that a transit room would be allocated to us from 3:30 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. on the day of our departure. On our second evening, the turndown service was once again not carried out. When we called reception, we were given the same explanation: that we had supposedly activated the "Do Not Disturb" sign. After explaining that this was not the case, the service was eventually sent to our room. We were then advised that it might take some time, as only three staff members were providing turndown service for the entire hotel. We can understand that operational constraints may occasionally arise, but they should not result in such a significant deterioration of the guest experience at a property of this standard. On the day of our departure, our check-out was scheduled for noon. We called reception to request that a bell attendant come and collect our luggage. We waited until housekeeping staff arrived and asked when we intended to vacate the room. We explained that we were ready to leave and were simply waiting for the bell attendant. The housekeeping team then had to contact reception themselves to have someone sent to our room. Later that afternoon, we also attempted to contact the WhatsApp concierge again regarding the transit room that had been confirmed to us. Once again, we received no response. At 3:30 p.m., we therefore went directly to reception. We were initially asked whether we had actually made such a request and whether it had been confirmed. After checking the WhatsApp conversation, the staff confirmed that the transit room had indeed been promised to us. After several phone calls, we were eventually told that the person who had responded to our request was an intern and that, in reality, no transit room had been reserved for us. The only alternative offered was for us to use the shower facilities at the spa. We declined this option, as it bore no resemblance to what had previously been confirmed to us. When settling our bill, we were asked whether we had enjoyed our stay. Naturally, we replied that we had not, given the number of issues we had encountered. The staff member offered to arrange for us to speak with a manager, which we accepted. She later returned to inform us that the manager was in a meeting and unavailable, while assuring us that he would come and speak with us before our departure. At 5:00 p.m., we boarded the boat transfer to leave the hotel. No manager had come to meet us, and the staff member who had been handling our departure was no longer present either. Beyond each individual incident, what particularly disappointed us was their repeated nature and the way they were handled: lack of follow-up, the need to repeatedly chase for responses, contradictory information, commitments not being honored, billing errors, and ultimately a complete lack of managerial handling despite our explicit request to speak with a manager. We have stayed at several competing properties in Bora Bora, and until now we had never experienced this level of inconsistency in service. To this day, no follow up was provided and our complaint email was left with no reply.

Unfortunately we had major issues during our stay. Let me start with construction - it was disclosed so I give the hotel credit for that. What is not disclosed is the extent and noise of the construction. It's intolerable. All day long. Jack hammers, power saws, hammering, and a crane! I would not have stayed here if I understood the construction situation. I worked in construction and don't mind a little noise, but this was really bad. Before you book here, I suggest you check on this situation and get an honest take on what's happening. Next: Be very careful riding the bikes. Most barely have brakes and I actually fell off because I couldn't stop! Seriously, I have a bike at home and enjoy riding. This is just simply dangerous and the bikes are very poorly maintained. Next - just to get to the hotel, we paid $90 per person each way for a boat ride to the hotel! Ridiculous. For a 5 star resort, this seems outrageous. I would think it would be included in the price, but that's just me. Next - I had a yummy aperol spritz that was $60! It feels like such gouge. The food is mediocre at best. There is a cool Polynesian show, but it's not available to hotel guests. It's only for those who are paying. So we have no idea what a Polynesian show is like after visiting Bora Bora. A shame! We didn't want to go to the show because it included a buffet dinner and we didn't like the type of food served. This hotel checks the mini bar every day to see if you have taken a soda. To me, this is so petty. A coke in the mini bar should be complimentary at a 5 star resort when you are staying on an island without any choices. It's just sodas! Checking the mini bar is common for hotels, but not at this level and price. This resort is so pretty but it doesn't feel special at all. We came to a 5 star resort in Bora Bora and were so bummed. The last thing I will mention is the beds. Ours was so soft, I woke up with back aches. The rooms are gorgeous, however. Having said all of that, I talked to the day manager about these issues and was offered one free night at any Hilton and lunch. I declined the one free night and chose to alert others as to what's going on here. Such a shame. I think there are much better alternatives. Two of the five restaurants that are touted by the hotel are Japanese and Chinese. The French Restaurant, as advertised, is closed and under construction. The menu has been moved to a restaurant that is on the sand and very casual.

I thought for a long time whether to write a review or not. But the situation with payment upon departure was a final disappointment. I will start my review with the pros. This is an incredibly beautiful place. Just a feast for the eyes. We booked the hotel several months ago. It was important to me that the villa was on the sand. We had two villas booked on the sand with direct access to the sea. But when we drove up to the hotel, I noticed that construction of new villas was going on in that area. We arrived at the hotel at 8:30 in the morning, and we were checked in immediately after a tour of the grounds. But they didn't put us in the villas we booked, but in the water villas. However, it was fundamentally important to us to live on the sand. What I feared happened: the sun was setting already after lunch, and on some windy days we were simply blown away, and swimming was impossible. I don't understand why the hotel didn't warn us in advance that the rooms in that category are undergoing renovation. Now about the service. Upon check-in, the hotel staff recorded our phone number for contact, but it didn't work here. They might not have answered us for several hours, and sometimes until the next day. Every new employee didn't remember what the previous one promised. The room is cleaned, but not always. They might have forgotten to bring the beach towels, take the glasses, and not return them. The mini-bar might not have been restocked for two days either. To restaurants, we liked the Chinese food. The breakfasts were not impressive. Poolside cocktails are a lottery, it all depends on the bartenders. Upon check-in, they asked for a credit card for payment, but we had cash. We clarified that we want to pay in cash, and we were assured twice that it is possible. And a surprise: when we checked out, they refused to accept cash, only card. Output: the hotel is beautiful, incredible. The sea is amazing. But the service is low for such a network.

review_title: Beautiful Bora Bora, but the Dining Experience Was Marred by Mosquitoes
review_text: We recently stayed at Conrad Bora Bora Nui and had a mixed experience. There is no question that the resort itself is stunning. The overwater villas are beautiful, the lagoon is breathtaking, and the staff were warm, friendly, and attentive throughout our stay. Unfortunately, one issue significantly impacted our vacation: the mosquito problem. We booked a package that included breakfast and dinner every day. However, during our stay, the resort's French restaurant was closed for renovation, so dinner was served exclusively at Tamure Grill. The Grill is an open-air restaurant located next to the pool, which unfortunately turned out to be the area with the worst mosquito problem on the property. Every meal became uncomfortable because we were constantly swatting mosquitoes while trying to eat. My children ended up with their legs covered in mosquito bites, despite using insect repellent. For a luxury resort at this price point, I expected much better mosquito management. Overall, Conrad Bora Bora Nui remains one of the most beautiful resorts we've visited, and the service was excellent. However, the severe mosquito issue unfortunately overshadowed what could have been a perfect family vacation.

review_title: Hotel was not ready to reopen
review_text: While the staff are wonderful and working incredibly hard despite the current constraints, and we genuinely appreciated our room upgrade, the hotel simply wasn't ready to reopen. The ongoing construction is so extensive that you cannot escape the sight, smell, or sound of it anywhere on the property. We stayed in a villa that was further from the work than most other rooms, but we still suffered from construction noise most days.

review_title: The Conrad Bora Bora: Our Happy Place
review_text: The Conrad Bora Bora has truly become our happy place. We've had the pleasure of visiting this stunning resort three times, and each stay has been nothing short of exceptional. From the moment you arrive, the friendly and accommodating staff make you feel right at home. Roger and his team consistently provide excellent service, going above and beyond to ensure guests feel seen and heard. Kevin and our personal concierge, Hansen, treated us with warmth and kindness. It was a wonderful way to kick off my daughter's 16th birthday. The ambience, stunning surroundings, and incredible service at Conrad Bora Bora have created beautiful memories for our family.

review_title: Private luxury meets warm Polynesian hospitality at CONRAD BORA BORA NUI!
review_text: I have nothing but amazing things to say about Conrad Bora Bora Nui. My husband and I celebrated our 21st anniversary and stayed at the King Overwater Pool Villa for five nights. Ours had updated digital controls, making the months of construction upgrade worthwhile. Conrad is strategically located on a separate island from the Bora Bora mainland, so our private infinity pool was situated in a turquoise atoll lagoon and actually facing the Pacific ocean, unlike other properties. We swam with colorful fish, and a group of sting rays and black-tipped friendly sharks wandered into the property. The food was divine and very tropical fresh! On our first night, we dined at Banyan Chinese Restaurant. We then had dinner every night at the Tamure Beach Grill, which served French cuisine since their restaurant was under renovation. Hina Spa at Conrad Bora Bora was probably one of the best spa locations we've been to. Conrad Bora Bora Nui was truly an unforgettable experience.

Bora Bora is an amazingly gorgeous place to visit. Booking with Costco Travel did not disappoint. Conrad Nui made our over the water bungalow experience a memorable one. While Conrad Nui is located on one of the longest stretches of private white sand beaches, the resort is surrounded by the most beautiful shades of crystal clear blue water imaginable. Some of the on-site activities available are kayaking, biking, snorkeling, and paddle boarding. There's a fully equipped spa that is perched on a hilltop embraced by unreal scenery. The friendly, attentive staff will enhance your experience by personalizing preferences, focusing attention to detail, and assisting with anything you need. It is worth mentioning the resort restaurants had incredible mouthwatering food options with magnificent service. We will definitely revisit Conrad Bora Bora Nui.

review_title: Exceptional Service and Unforgettable Family Memories
review_text: The staff throughout the property are incredibly warm, attentive, and accommodating. A special shout-out to our concierge, Hanson, who went above and beyond to create real "wow" moments for our kids and the whole family. The breakfast restaurant team deserves special mention as well. They remembered our names and preferences from day one, and every single morning our table was ready and waiting, with wonderful, attentive service throughout our stay. Our kids had the time of their lives at this resort. We had so much fun as a family that we booked our return trip for next year before we even checked out!

review_title: A stunning location, but not the Conrad experience we expected
review_text: We stayed at Conrad Bora Bora Nui in May 2026 to celebrate our honeymoon and my 50th birthday. Bora Bora had been a dream destination of ours for years, and Conrad felt like the natural choice - we have stayed at many Conrad properties around the world and have always had very positive experiences with the brand. On arrival at the airport, we were welcomed by the Westin team, who kindly greeted us with flower leis. Although our flight details had been provided in advance, no Conrad representative was present. As we arrived early, we had to wait for our room to become available. That was completely fine and something we know from other Conrad and Waldorf Astoria properties. We were surprised, however, to be charged for breakfast on the day of arrival, since our breakfast entitlement officially only started the following day. While technically correct, this was something we had never encountered at any other Conrad property. [Note: capture partial - review continues beyond this point but was truncated during collection; the recorded portion establishes the buried-negative theme of inconsistent Conrad brand-standard delivery despite a 3-star overall rating.]

We had the opportunity to take a family trip for 6 nights to the Conrad Bora Bora and it didn't disappoint. The property is beautiful with a mixture of over water and land based bungalows. The tropical hills above the resort where the Hina spa sat was a perfect place to watch the sunrise. What stood out about this resort compared to some of the others in the Lagoon was the contrasting landscape of mountain and sea as well as areas where there was deep water (up to 15') off of the patio, which my kids loved for jumping into. The deep clear blue water was magical. The people made the difference, each so kind and helpful throughout the trip. As with any of the lagoon resorts, you can never get used to the food and beverage expenses so be prepared for that. Outside of that, this is a wonderful resort and highly recommended.

review_title: Spectacular stay at the Conrad Bora Bora
review_text: My husband and I had an unbelievable experience during our 5 night stay from start to finish! We were upgraded to an over the water bungalow with a pool and got a welcome bottle of wine and chocolates too! We knew in advance that construction would still be taking place, but in no way did it interfere with our stay at the resort. Every meal we had from breakfast to dinner was fantastic as well as the staff throughout the resort! The snorkeling off of our bungalow was amazing and we enjoyed kayaking as well. We treated ourselves to a day of relaxation at the Hina Spa and it was the best experience we have ever had at a spa! We loved the location of this resort away from all of the other resorts and the views are breathtaking everywhere you look!

We just returned from our trip to the Conrad Bora Bora and overall had a quite disappointing stay. Our disappointment started even prior to arrival. Where-as the St Regis proactively reached out ahead of time to set up dinner reservations, I had to reach out to the Conrad concierge to get menus and opening dates and then never received a response back despite follow up emails. I had also shared with both the concierge and GM we were traveling for our 10 year wedding anniversary and upon arrival to the Conrad, this wasn't acknowledged at all. What maybe disappointed me the most was the overall upkeep of the Conrad. We were put in a room at the far end of the resort where there was constantly a standing pond of water that smelled like sewage. We couldn't even sit out on our patio because it smelt so bad yet nothing was done about it. On the various walkways to the main part of the resort were damaged and cracked tiles and walkways that were literally falling apart. The views from the beach were disappointing as the ocean view is primarily blocked by bungalows. I was disappointed by the lack of beach service. While there during our 7 night stay, I got incredibly sick. So sick that a medic had to be called and I had to be transported to Vaitape to the ER and was ultimately diagnosed with cholecystitis (gallbladder inflammation) requiring fluids and prescription medication. To the Conrad's credit, they navigated this system incredibly to facilitate transportation. However, I was disappointed that after we returned no one from management reached out to inquire how I was doing or to see if I needed anything. Last disappointed was the so called Coffee House - we ordered an iced latte and the person working had no idea what we were asking, we were ultimately just given plain iced coffee that tasted terrible yet were still charged in full. Additional things we DID like: snorkeling was great, and food was better than expected, we really enjoyed the Chinese and French restaurants. Overall, we were disappointed by our stay.

This is my second stay at the Conrad Bora Bora and I've got to give Christophe the GM all of the credit in the world. We were not happy with our room this year (felt like we got downgraded) and Christophe (who has only been in the role for a week) went absolutely above and beyond and after a day of coordinating managed to get us into a sunset facing overwater villa. He's just the nicest person with an awesome demeanor.

review_title: Beautiful Resort, but still lots of construction
review_text: We just returned from a week stay here. We were disappointed by the amount of construction still going on at the resort. It definitely takes away from a relaxing atmosphere. We thought most of the construction would be finished by the time we arrived. The hotel was closed for several months for renovations and reopened May 1st. We stayed in one of the refurbished overwater bungalows. The room is beautiful and so is the view. However, they are still refurbishing many of the surrounding bungalows so there is some construction noise (hammering, saws, nail-guns). I would say half of the bungalows are being refurbished, so there is no way to escape construction noise. The French Restaurant IRIATAI was closed for renovations. All of the shops were closed except the pearl shop. PROS - The staff and service are wonderful. The food is excellent, but expensive. The new rooms are beautiful, but the TV cabinet at the end of the bed intrudes on the ocean view from the bed. We probably would have stayed somewhere else or booked for next year had we known about the ongoing construction. We made the best of it and had a nice stay, but it wasn't worth the $25,000 we paid to stay here.

review_title: Probably the best hotel we have ever stayed at.
review_text: Stayed at this hotel for 5 nights. Could not fault it in any way. Outstanding facilities, staff and food. Crystal clear waters under bungalows. Great to chill at the resort or use a base for excursions. The sunset lagoon trip is well worth doing. The customer service and engagement is amazing.

review_title: The people, the food, and the views deserve a 5. The facility will improve but for now it is a 3. Hence a 4 rating!
review_text: There is much to like and much to dislike about my stay here. Despite me including my confirmation numbers, they had our arrival date wrong. The views are incredible. A very common thread is the very sweet, kind, helpful people here. The food while very expensive (e.g. $10.50 for a bottle of water) is excellent. Now I have to address the facility itself. I had already heard that construction delays had happened here and tried to cancel my stay. Hilton would not allow the cancellation. Our initial bungalow was spacious and beautiful, but there were issues: the floor was quite dirty, there was no conditioner, the bicycle seat was pointed upward, we could not cast to the tv and it had no streaming apps, the curtain was not on the rod properly, and worst of all there was loud construction noise and an unsightly crane. The stores and one restaurant were all closed due to construction. We immediately noted the numerous bare areas in the grass and the missing tiles in the walkway. We were moved to a new bungalow but lost our view of the sunrise and mountain, and gained a 24/7 clicking noise. We also had a strong sewage smell from yesterday afternoon until this morning. They have the thermostat set so that only a mechanic can lower it below 71 degrees. I should have been allowed to cancel my reservation, for I paid way too much for things not having been completed.

review_title: Eloping here was one of the best decisions we've ever made!
review_text: The Conrad Bora Bora Nui has went above and beyond exceptional for our elopement/first time here! The resort in itself is absolutely gorgeous. Esmeralda, our wedding planner/concierge took phenomenal care of us. We did the hibiscus package which included a private island ceremony, photographer, dancers, band, officiant, marriage certification, champagne, breakfast by canoe, private dinner, couples massage, romantic turn down service. Even Kevin, the manager, came out and was excited to meet us. This will go down as one of the best decisions we've ever made!

review_title: Pure Paradise With World Class Service
review_text: Our experience at Conrad Bora Bora Nui was honestly beyond anything we could have imagined. From the second we arrived, every single person made us feel welcomed, celebrated, and genuinely cared for. A huge thank you to Kevin, Poema, and especially Esmeralda for making our wedding experience absolutely perfect. The property itself is breathtaking, the food was incredible, the service was world class.

My husband and I had an amazing time! Everything was perfect! The staff was so great, making us always feel like a VIP customer. We were treated well as a diamond member and upgraded to an over the water bungalow. The room was gorgeous and so roomy! Our favorite restaurant was the Banyan Chinese Restaurant. From start to finish everything was 5 star! I highly recommend this resort.
The day pass is amazing. An expensive experience but so good!!!!! (Machine translated)

review_title: How they handled my cancelled reservation -- not good
review_text: They cancelled my reservation. Fine, due to renovations. These things happen. I reached out directly to the property, and after nine phone calls, I was told that my reservation "on points" was essentially less deserving of accommodation than if I had paid with cash. I still have no resolution. I was also told that I should refer to the "points calendar" to secure a future date for my reservation. I also reached out directly to the General Manager, Roger Godin, who initially responded immediately, but who has since gone silent.

We stayed at Bora Bora, Conrad Hotel to celebrate my husband's 50th. There were areas (in my opinion) that Conrad can improve on. We were charged erroneously in the last day of our trip. Thank goodness we took pictures of the receipt, bc then it would be he said she said. Overall, everyone is nice. We want to point out Timia and her team were exceptional. And we really enjoyed their breakfast buffet and their courteous service.

review_title: Refined and polished for an exceptional experience all around.
review_text: The Conrad Bora Bora Nui now sits firmly in a more confident, fully realized phase, this being my 8th visit. The property has seen significant improvements just within the past 5 months. Accommodations are meticulously maintained. Maintenance is proactive rather than reactive. Housekeeping operates with quiet precision. Dining now reflects a higher level of confidence and consistency; the Iriati French restaurant has notably raised its game. Service in the dining venues deserves particular recognition. The spa remains a standout. Recreational offerings continue to be robust. Ongoing renovations during this stay had an even lighter footprint than before, with minimal impact on daily enjoyment - active renovation work was being performed at the far ends of the resort, with significant distance between bungalows and active work. What ultimately distinguishes the Conrad Bora Bora Nui at this stage is its maturity.

review_title: One remarkable person who makes us want to return!!
review_text: Our stay at Conrad Bora Bora Nui was absolutely amazing and truly unforgettable. While the resort itself is stunning, one of the main reasons we would return is Zuzana, an exceptional guest relations manager. The resort offers a fantastic pool, a beautiful beach, and breathtaking views everywhere you look. The rooms are elegant and comfortable. The food was very good, and the service throughout the resort was excellent.

review_title: Immaculate service throughout with everything expected and beyond
review_text: Had an exceptional babymoon vacation at the Conrad. What stands out is the intimacy amongst the staff and the guests. Huge shoutout to zuzanna for the great tour and Lydia for all the guest service arrangements. Florie at breakfast was another standout. Thank you Roger for running such a fantastic property and upholding such great service and consistency. Insider tip noted: renovations not a concern.

review_title: Amazing Views and Food, but Room Upgrade Experience Fell Short
review_text: We had a wonderful honeymoon stay at the Conrad, and overall it was an incredible experience. The overwater bungalow was amazing, the turn-down service was excellent, and the rooms were beautiful. The food at every restaurant we visited was absolutely delicious. However, there were a few disappointments. We were told we needed to sign upgrade paperwork before arriving. The contract listed the upgrade at $600 per night, even though we had been told over the phone it would be $62 per night. Receiving the final bill felt very deceiving given the large discrepancy. When we expressed our frustration, the customer service response felt dismissive rather than solution-oriented. We also experienced poor service at one restaurant on our first night - it took 20 minutes to get water, and I had to ask three separate times for a fork. Our wristbands stopped working in the rain, and later we didn't receive turn-down service despite a text thread confirming our request. For the price, we're not sure we would stay here again.

From the moment we arrived, we knew this was the most stunning place we had ever seen. Every single staff member we interacted with was absolutely delightful. We loved all of the restaurants, and they were incredibly accommodating of my gluten-free diet due to celiac disease - staff made gluten-free crepes and pancakes for me every morning. We stayed in one of the overwater bungalows, and it was everything we hoped for and more. We absolutely loved this resort and would recommend it to anyone.

It was our first time in Bora Bora and it was beyond our expectation. We were in the villa on the mountain side with a pool and were happier with our land villa than an overwater one. The hotel itself is clean and the staff so nice and friendly. However, we felt like the road needs more maintenance as there were a lot of tiles missing. The greeter we had, Mary, was the least favorite person we met there - she was not helpful at all and never replied to our messages. A special thanks to the manager of reception, Bozek, who was the most elegant and graceful manager ever.

We had a beautiful stay in an upgraded villa overlooking the ocean. Meals and service were all excellent, and we want to specifically call out Manate for her warmth, hospitality, friendliness and humanity. No construction noise or issues with cleanliness (everything was spotless and well-manicured) but expect the roosters to wake you up early like a typical alarm clock!

Our stay at the Conrad Bora Bora was absolutely wonderful. The resort is stunning, surrounded by crystal-clear water and breathtaking views. The villas are spacious, elegant, and very comfortable. The staff were incredibly kind and attentive, always making sure we had everything we needed. The food was delicious with a great variety of options. Everything about this resort exceeded our expectations — a true paradise!

An unforgettable stay at the Conrad Bora Bora Nui! We had an absolutely magical time. The setting is exceptional, turquoise water, beautiful beach and breathtaking views. The staff is incredibly attentive and warm, always ready to help with a smile. The accommodation was spacious, perfectly clean and very comfortable, with incredible views. The restaurants offer varied and delicious dishes, and the service is impeccable. A real paradise on earth! I recommend 100% for a unique and memorable experience. [Machine Translated]

We had an amazing stay at the Conrad Bora Bora. Everything was perfect — from the beautiful setting to the warm and professional staff. The food was excellent, with great variety and quality throughout our stay. Each meal was a real pleasure, and the service was always attentive and friendly. Highly recommended!

review_title: Amazing tropical vacation, and one of the friendliest stays we've ever had
review_text: My husband and I just returned from 8 nights at the Conrad Bora Bora. We bought a package through Costco Travel, so we didn't receive any incentives or points through the hotel. This was definitely one of our favorite vacations, and it was a standout as having the friendliest staff of any place we've visited. From the moment we pulled up in the boat around 10am, they made us feel special, gave us a welcome drink, and booked restaurant reservations for us. They made sure to let us know we were a priority and they would do their best to get us in a room as soon as possible (even though check-in time was 3pm). Our concierge walked us to the breakfast restaurant, and shortly after we were done they had our villa ready for us, and our bags already in the room. The rest of our stay was just lovely. The villa was gorgeous of course, but the staff is really what made it so special. I'm very embarrassed to say that I don't recall people's names (this is a weakness of mine), but by the third day we were greeted by name at the breakfast and lunch restaurant, and they also knew our table and drink preferences. When walking around the property staff would always wave at us and greet us in passing. I also saw staff talking and laughing with each other when they passed. The overall feeling at this property is one of great warmth, and friendliness. We were told before we came that there was going to be some construction and we were a bit worried about this, but our stay was never impacted at all by it. I cannot recommend this property enough.

review_title: A Once-in-a-Lifetime Experience – Conrad Bora Bora Nui
review_text: Getting to Bora Bora took us almost two full days, but from the moment we arrived at the Conrad, we knew it was worth every minute of travel. During our 10-day stay, we had the rare chance to experience all four seasons - sunshine, rain, clouds, and even one wild night of strong winds! While that windy night wasn't exactly fun, the rest of our stay was absolutely magical. The resort itself is spotless - truly one of the cleanest places I've ever seen - and the attention to detail is remarkable. The moment we stepped off the boat, Daven greeted us and took care of us throughout our stay with such warmth and professionalism that we instantly felt at home. There may not be a huge variety of restaurants on the property, but the quality of the food more than makes up for it. We especially loved the Chinese and French cuisine, both prepared to perfection. A big thank to Sylvana from the French restaurant and the breakfast team led by Timia - they were the absolute stars of our mornings! Their smiles, cheerful good mornings, and thoughtful care made us start every day on the brightest note. Every staff member we encountered was kind, attentive, and genuinely happy to make guests feel welcome. If you're looking for a peaceful, relaxing getaway where you can reconnect with nature and enjoy quality time with your partner or family, this is the perfect place. The views are breathtaking, the colors of the ocean look unreal, and the swimming and snorkeling are just fantastic.

We celebrated the renewal of our wedding promise and booked a corresponding wedding package. After arrival we were horrified, because the responsible employee showed no interest in answering our questions or explaining the process to us. Actually, we wanted to change the hotel, but then our angel Suzana came. This young woman is nicknamed Superwoman for a reason! With a lot of love and commitment she made our day an experience we will never forget. The hotel is currently being renovated and will also be completely closed for 3 months at the beginning of 2026. We were not affected by the work, only the furnishing of the bungalows has just come of age. With the overwater bungalows, I would strongly recommend making another entry into the water, because the current one is almost impossible for people with a lightweight mobile phone cap. The food in the 3 restaurants is of good quality, especially excellent is the patisserie. We had half board and it did not become apparent to us why you have to pay for dinner in one restaurant for e.g. a steak and not for the very same in the other restaurant. [Machine Translated]

This was our third stay at the Conrad Bora Bora Nui in the last 13 months. We were elated to learn that Zuzana Miksova had been promoted to Guest Experience Manager. Zuzana has hosted us in each of our stays and she is an exceptional talent. We stayed in a renovated overwater bungalow in the 100 section. The outdoor deck area is improved with the decking replaced, a new shower, and upgraded netting and furnishings. The new user-friendly touch-screen control panel is a welcomed update. The Housekeeping team is one of the best in the world. Lydia, aka, Melie, and Anne Marie made sure that we were well taken care of. Lahaina was our housekeeper most days and she was outstanding. The Recreation Team led by their affectionate Director of Recreation Francoise took great care of us during our entire stay. We were again pleased with our experiences at the Hina Spa. We enjoyed meals at all restaurants as well as in room dining. The front office team does an excellent job and has always been very efficient with our check in and check out. We have spent a total of 31 nights at the Conrad Bora Bora Nui during our 3 stays.

That's why we would never book Conrad Bora Bora Nui again! The first days were really nice. On Monday lunchtime opposite our bungalow was a construction site and steel beams were installed. The next morning we started at 7am and there was no rest until evening. Besides, the food at the hotel was outrageously expensive for the quality and the service super lousy. My husband had his plates taken away while he was eating. On the last day it suddenly got super hot in our room — we were simply deprived of the air conditioning during operation, completely removed from the device while it was running. We appointed the hotel manager and were told they know the problems but their hands are tied, instructions from above. A staff member at the hotel said they would like to hide under the bed and cry sometimes when showing the bungalows because they would find it so bad. Because of our complaint we did not have to pay our costs on the spot, but that does not change the fact that one should not support the policy of the hotel. You would have to completely block the site, because it is not habitable. [Machine Translated]

I highly recommend Conrad Bora Bora. Everything is as perfect — the room, the staff, the food, the color of the water! The service was incredible especially Skyano and Abdulay. They made the stay extra special. Unfortunately you don't see Mt. Otemanu from the resort. I recommend that you divide your trip between 2 resorts to make the most of the views.

review_title: We witnessed a "Masterclass" in Hospitality by Zuzana
review_text: Our daily interactions with Guest Experience Manager Mrs. Zuzana Miksova is always the highlight of our trip. Hospitality isn't what she does it is part of her DNA. This was our third stay and Zuzana has raised the bar each time. She reached out to us before our arrival to assist with excursions, restaurant reservations and to schedule our spa appointment. We have stayed at many luxury properties with personal concierge services but the guest experience with Zuzana is the standard by which all others are measured against. She is the benchmark!!! Guest Experience Zuzana Miksova is a Rock-star!!! She is the reason we will continue to return to the Conrad Bora Bora Nui.

Our honeymoon was just amazing! Service, rooms and the entire complex were impeccable. We were greeted with particular attention upon entering the room, which was very appreciable. The different restaurants offered tasty and varied cuisine, allowing us to discover new flavors every day. A big thank you to Adrijan for his attentive support throughout our stay and to Uppa for his good contagious humor that brightened our days. We will definitely be back! [Machine Translated]

review_title: Zuzana Sets the Standard for True 5-Star Hospitality at Conrad Bora Bora Nui
review_text: We've been visiting the Conrad Bora Bora for six years now—six visits in total—and while we have always loved the property, it wasn't until we met Zuzana, the Guest Relations Manager, in 2023 that the resort truly reached a 5-star standard. Zuzana embodies genuine hospitality. Her warmth, professionalism, and attention to detail elevate every stay into a luxurious and personalized experience. What makes Zuzana truly exceptional is that her care extends to every guest, not just us. Zuzana is the reason we continue to return year after year, and her leadership sets the gold standard for hospitality at Conrad Bora Bora Nui.

I have found my forever vacation spot. Unreal experience. The staff go above and beyond, without bothering you. A place where peace and love are both one. Can't wait to return! [Insider tip: Enjoy sunrise every morning!]

We stayed for 3 nights and experienced the most wonderful customer care ever! From arrival to departure you are treated with a smile and helpfulness, we never met before! There is nothing the staff won't accomplish to guest satisfaction! We initially had an apartment on the land, due to a small technical issue we changed, being upgraded to a waterfront villa! Rooms are perfect, irrespective of range. Breakfast is with large choice, for all tastes. Concierge is extremely helpful. Special thanks to Kevin, the manager, who understood and met our needs.

From the moment we were picked up at the airport in Bora Bora, the Conrad staff took care of our every need. Ester made dinner reservations, the cleaning staff placed our slippers bedside and lit incense for turndown service, wait staff greeted us by name and every employee greeted us when they passed by. The service here is truly 5 star and the accommodations are jaw dropping! Our overwater bungalow was gorgeous, as was the crystal blue water beneath it. The food was delicious and beautifully presented at every meal.

review_title: Avoid the Conrad Bora Bora – Entire Resort Under Construction and Not Worth the Price
review_text: The Conrad Bora Bora is Under Construction. This resort should not be open to guests right now. The property is under major construction, with constant noise and large sections completely closed off. They don't mention this anywhere in their advertisements or booking information, which is misleading. Even the areas that are open feel old and clearly awaiting renovation. It's not worth the money. Find another place to stay until the work is finished — you'll thank yourself later. [Insider tip: Resort Under Construction!! Pick another place]

We had a wonderful stay at the Conrad! The staff was amazing, and Sophie in particular went above and beyond to make us feel cared for. When my wife had a minor allergic reaction to some of the products in our bungalow, the team quickly found hypoallergenic alternatives, which we truly appreciated. Our overwater bungalow was stunning, and we already miss waking up to those beautiful views. Highly recommend this resort for both its beauty and exceptional service!

review_title: Great Experience at Conrad Bora Bora
review_text: We had a wonderful stay at the Conrad Bora Bora. From the moment we arrived, Daven warmly welcomed us and took care of us throughout our visit, making everything feel seamless. The service across the resort was excellent, and the staff as a whole were genuinely attentive and friendly. The location is stunning, and snorkeling here is some of the best we've experienced in Bora Bora. Our Diamond benefits were fully recognized, which we really appreciated, and the thoughtful touch of providing a transit room on our last day made departure so much more comfortable. There are some ongoing renovations at the property right now. They didn't bother us much during our stay, but they may be noticeable to some travelers. We look forward to returning when everything is fully refreshed in 2026.

Beautiful resort. Nice and friendly staff. Special thanks to Olivier at the pool/beach for great service. Great food. The breakfast buffet was good, with a great choice of food. Room was clean but for a luxurious and expensive hotel, I didn't expect the hand wash to be broken. Very poor Wi-fi connection at the beach. The response via WhatsApp communication was delayed. A piece of feedback for the staff called guest relations – they should be more personalized and proactive, reach out and ask how the guest is doing, whether they need anything, or offer suggestions.

review_title: Recommend this hotel, where we had a pleasant stay
review_text: Very nice hotel, staff listening to its clientele, spacious room, and very clean. Top restoration with regional steps. Hearty breakfast. [Machine Translated]

Amazing resort! Immaculate rooms, wonderful staff, great food! One of a few places that the actual resort lives up to or even exceeds the online photos. Can't say enough about the over the top service and friendliness of the staff, from Esther our concierge to Olivier at the pool as well as Paul and Caroline in the ocean activity center.

We had an overwater bungalow no305, which was lovely. A nice comfy bed, a good shower, everything was great. The breakfast was very good, with a great choice of food. The food is very good in all the restaurants, the staff are lovely. This place is a little piece of paradise, we had a really relaxing and enjoyable time. There is a free ferry to the main island everyday. There are many trips that you can do, that are booked through the hotel. A top rate hotel.

Beautiful resort with top notch service. Attention to detail making our stay memorable. The breakfast buffet had everything imaginable. Every staff member was friendly and helpful. We were upgraded to the Presidential Villa which was a huge surprise! The sunsets were amazing from this location. [Insider tip: Request a sunset view villa. Nothing tops the sunset from Bora Bora!]

I came to Conrad Bora Bora to celebrate my birthday, and it was a dream. From the airport, Adrian welcomed us and gave a tour around the whole property. As a Diamond member, I was upgraded to a beach villa with lagoon access and a beautiful view, and the hotel surprised me with a cake and champagne that made my birthday unforgettable. The breakfast buffet was delicious, and all the staff greeted us with smiles and called us by name. We ate at all the restaurants such as French Iriatai, Upa Upa, Banyan, and Beach Grill so every dish was made with love, and the service was amazing. At Nina Spa, I had two massages and a facial with Deli who did a fantastic job. Also, housekeeping was top-notch, coming twice a day. On our last day, Bella decorated our villa with flowers. This stay gave me the best birthday celebration in my life.

review_title: Service from the French is 2 out of 5. Wouldn't return.
review_text: Conrad Bora Bora was a solid 3.5 out of 5. Pros: the pastries at the breakfast buffet was a stand out. The over the water bungalows were beautiful and the swim out was exceptional. There is a lot of privacy in each of the bungalows. The fitness center had everything you needed. The outside buffet with fire dancers were a highlight, amazing seafood. Cons: For such an expensive and luxurious place there is ZERO free drinking water with the exception of water at the fitness center. They don't even give you water in the bungalows. The service of the French restaurant is absolutely atrocious, little left to be desired and always felt like we were a bother. The food: very small portions and with everything in Bora it costs $50 per burger (plain) and $35+ for drinks. The French staff were unfriendly and pretentious. On the other hand Tahitian staff always wore a smile on their face and quite welcoming. Wouldn't return to this resort and pay what we paid due to the ungodly poor service.
